_comment: Copy this file to convene-adapters.json (same directory) and edit for your setup. Each top-level key is an actor name you can pass to --origin, --actor <slot>=<actor>, or a profile's default_actor. convene-adapters.json is gitignored by default so populated entries never get committed by accident.

opencode._comment: Example: dispatch to the OpenCode CLI. Adjust argv to match how your installed version reads a prompt from stdin.

my-local-model._comment: Example: a custom wrapper script around any local or vendor CLI. The prompt is piped to this command's stdin; its stdout becomes the slot's response.
